name: Virgo Global Limited
about: Virgo Global Limited engages in the manufacturing, trading, and dealing and maintenance of computer hardware and software. The company provides computer systems, data processors assembly, and program designs. It also buys and sells hardware and software packages, tabulating and accounting machines, calculators, computerized telecommunication systems and network, spare parts, equipment and devices, components, etc. The company was formerly known as Virgo Global Media Limited. Virgo Global Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
